text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Mirrormon] & [Kabemon] & [Copipemon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Jamming＞ ＜Retaliation＞ [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [Leviathan] trait from your hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] When any of your opponent's Digimon suspend, by trashing 1 of this Digimon's link cards, ＜Draw 1＞ and gain 1 memory.
